craft_notes: Sthāyin: volley (four candidate forms). Music: question-mark across the break (line 2 loads three). Rows: row 2 (alternatives uncut). Close: which (open). Read aloud: nine-self? three-head? triad? Rejected: choosing one — killed: all four are her guesses; numbering the candidates — killed: breath runs.

lines: Nine-self division? Bhairava in his form?
three-head split? power-triad? which is it?
l4.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ vā navātmabhedena bhairave bhairavākṛtau | triśirobhedabhinnaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktitrayātmakam

reads_against.argmap: Which form is it truly? → Four candidate forms are flung as alternatives, none yet chosen.
